request.style: English, smooth female jazz vocal, upright bass, brushed drums, piano, muted trumpet, warm and nostalgic mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
From Babylon the dust has cleared
The list of names is finally near
Two thousand one hundred seventy-two
The sons of Parosh start anew

[Chorus]
We came back with Zerubbabel
To build the temple, to stand
The genealogy is written clear
In the shadow of the land

[Verse]
Zechariah leads the group
One hundred fifty men to prove
The lineage held through time and tide
With Ezra we have arrived

[Chorus]
We came back with Zerubbabel
To build the temple, to stand
The genealogy is written clear
In the shadow of the land

[Verse]
Ramiah and Izziah stand
Malchijah and Eleazar
Mijamin and Benaiah too
Names called out in view

[Bridge]
Pedaiah the son of Parosh
Repairs the wall with care
Beside the court of the guard
The tower rising high there

[Chorus]
We came back with Zerubbabel
To build the temple, to stand
The genealogy is written clear
In the shadow of the land

[Outro]
The covenant is sealed once more
The sons of Parosh forever
